product.description: Monoprice™70V Music & Paging Speaker (each) [BS‑7C‑128P]An excellent economical choice for commercial audio installations, this speaker offers an optimal blend of flexibility, efficiency, and dependability for background audio and paging applications.Introducing the Monoprice™ 70V Music & Paging Speaker, a reliable and efficient audio solution designed specifically for commercial background music and paging. This speaker is the perfect audio solution for a variety of settings including retail stores, restaurants, schools, malls, and more.Designed with practicality in mind, this speaker is well‑suited for T‑Bar drop ceilings. The installation is a breeze and it fits seamlessly into your existing ceiling structure, making it a convenient choice for your commercial spaces.With its wide‑angle sound dispersion, the Monoprice™ 70V Music & Paging Speaker covers more area with fewer speakers. This means cost savings for you while still ensuring your announcements or background music reaches every part of your venue.Another key feature of this speaker is its dual‑cone design. This makes the speaker more sensitive than traditional coaxial speakers, providing greater volume output with less amplifier power. You can achieve the same volume with a lower‑powered, more cost‑effective amplifier, or add more speakers to get more coverage without having to upgrade the amplifier power.Speaking of amplifier power, the Monoprice™ 70V Music & Paging Speaker features five 70V transformer taps to help use that power more efficiently. This provides maximum system flexibility and allows you to tailor the audio output and amplifier power to your specific needs.The speaker features a low‑profile grill, blending seamlessly into your ceiling for a clean and unobtrusive look. Despite its discreet appearance, it packs a punch with a 20W max/10W RMS power handling capability.Experience the practicality and efficiency with our Monoprice™ 70V Music & Paging Speaker‑where good sound meets sleek design.Designed for commercial background audio and pagingPerfect for retail stores, restaurants, schools, malls, etc.Wide‑angle sound dispersion for better coverageSleek design with unobtrusive speaker grillFive 70V transformer taps for maximum system flexibility20W max/10W RMS power handling BACKGROUND AUDIO & PAGINGThe perfect solution for background music and paging in retail stores, restaurants, schools, malls, and other commercial applications. DUAL‑CONE DESIGNThe dual cone design provides a wider dispersion angle (120°) than traditional tweeters, which means you can cover a broader area with fewer speakers. LOW‑PROFILE SPEAKER GRILLThe low‑profile grill is less than a 1/4" thick at only 5 mm, and the white‑painted grill blends in well with most acoustic ceiling tiles. FIVE TRANSFORMER TAPSThe transformer tap wires on the back of the speaker allow you to balance its output with additional speakers on the same amplifier channel. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x Speaker • 1x User Manual Pick The Perfect Speaker That Fits Your Needs.comp-img {max-height: 300px}.comp-copy-col {background-color:#F1F1F1}  P/N4494844949Woofer size8"8"Woofer Cone MaterialPaperPaperTweeter SizeN/AN/ATweeter MaterialN/AN/AFrequency Response126Hz‑13 kHz126Hz‑13 kHzPower Handling RMS/Max10W/20W5W/10WSensitivity93 dB93 dBImpedance8Ω8ΩTransformer Tap Settings10W‑5W‑2.5W‑1.25W5W‑2.5W‑1.25W‑0.63W‑0.32WDimensions13.0" x 3.07"(330 mm x 78 mm)13.0" x 3.07"(330 mm x 78 mm)Weight3.35 lbs (1.52 kg)3.26 lbs (1.48 kg).gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
